name: Theme
description: Theme singleton managing CSS custom property application for dark/light modes across 3 palettes (default, monokai, idol). Each palette defines 14 color tokens (bg, surface, panel, primary, secondary, tertiary, border, accent, accent2, green, amber, red, onAccent, scrim). Supports legacy theme name migration ('dark'/'light'/'monokai' → base+mode). Applies colors to document.documentElement via style.setProperty on every change.

interface.constructor: new Theme() — instantiated once as 'theme' singleton

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Set both base and mode, with legacy name fallback

methods.name: setDark
methods.description: Set default palette to dark or light

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggle between dark and light mode

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Write all 14 CSS custom properties to documentElement

lifecycle.created_by: Module import (auto-instantiated, apply called on import)
